description: Get the NS Pros analysis report for a course by name, e.g. query "Augusta National": scorecard character, difficulty (official USGA slope/rating where published, otherwise a clearly labelled NS Pros estimate), hardest holes and who the course suits. An NS Pros processed report — not raw data. License: Mixed: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 (course index and scorecards) + GolfCore course data (golfcore.org).
